name: NTE Damage Chain Reaction
description: Captures real player-to-target CharacterOnDamaged events and, when enabled, continuously reapplies the exact Core-validated native GameplayEffect against the same target at a configurable repeat rate (1–100 times per second). The chain has no fixed total-hit limit and stops when no fresh matching damage event arrives within 2 seconds or the feature is disabled. It does not replay player input, skills, or animations and does not directly write target HP.
author: Anomaly
